course.name: want / need / plan to + 动词
course.explanation: want、need、plan 后面通常用 to + 动词原形。plan to 表示计划做。

sentences.en: I want to listen to a podcast for a while.
sentences.wrong: I want listen to a podcast.

sentences.en: I need to review these sentence patterns.
I plan to go out this weekend.
sentences.wrong: I plan going out this weekend.

sentences.en: I want to improve my speaking.
I need to go to bed earlier.
sentences.wrong: I need go to bed earlier.

sentences.en: I plan to do my homework tomorrow.
sentences.wrong: I plan do my homework tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 我想学会自然地表达自己。
sentences.en: I want to express myself naturally.
I need to charge my phone.
I want to try another game.
I plan to travel during summer break.
sentences.wrong: I plan traveling during summer break.
